## Umbral Dragon, Old (CR 17)

**XP** 102,400  
 CE Gargantuan dragon (extraplanar)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +30; **Aura** frightful presence (240 ft., DC 26)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 32, touch 5, flat-footed 32 (-1 Dex, +27 natural, -4 size)  
 **hp** 378 (21d12+126)  
 **Fort** +18, **Ref** +11, **Will** +18  
 **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** cold, death effects, negative energy, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 28  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)  
 **Melee** bite +27 (4d6+15/19–20), 2 claws +27 (2d8+10), tail slap +25 (2d8+15) and 2 wings +25 (2d6+5)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (50-ft. cone, 16d8 negative energy, DC 26), crush (4d6+15, DC 26), shadow breath (8 Str), tail sweep (2d6+15, DC 26)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 21st; concentration +27)  

 At will—*[darkness](../../magic/spells/darkness.md)*, *project imag*e (DC 23), *[shadow walk](../../magic/spells/shadow-walk.md)*, *[vampiric touch](../../magic/spells/vampiric-touch.md)*  

 **Spells Known** (CL 11th; concentration +17)  

 5th (5/day)—*[slay living](../../magic/spells/slay-living.md)*, *[unhallow](../../magic/spells/unhallow.md)* (DC 21)  
4th (7/day)—*[enervation](../../magic/spells/enervation.md)*, *[inflict critical wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-critical-wounds.md)* (DC 20), *[unholy blight](../../magic/spells/unholy-blight.md)* (DC 20)  
3rd (7/day)—*[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*, *[haste](../../magic/spells/haste.md)*, *[inflict serious wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-serious-wounds.md)* (DC 19), *[lightning bolt](../../magic/spells/lightning-bolt.md)* (DC 19)  
2nd (8/day)—*alter self, blur, command undead* (DC 18), *[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[web](../../magic/spells/web.md)* (DC 18)  
1st (8/day)—*[grease](../../magic/spells/grease.md)* (DC 17), *[inflict light wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-light-wounds.md)* (DC 17), *[magic missile](../../magic/spells/magic-missile.md)*, *[reduce person](../../magic/spells/reduce-person.md)* (DC 17), *[shield* ](../../magic/spells/shield.md)  
0 (at will)—*[acid splash](../../magic/spells/acid-splash.md)*, bleed (DC 16), *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*, *[disrupt undead](../../magic/spells/disrupt-undead.md)* (DC 16), *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[ray of frost](../../magic/spells/ray-of-frost.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 31, **Dex** 8, **Con** 23, **Int** 22, **Wis** 23, **Cha** 22  
 **Base Atk** +21; **CMB** +35; **CMD** 44 (48 vs trip)  
 **Feats** Bleeding Critical
